# Mochi Compose

> Android Jetpack Compose UI library (`minSdk` 23, `compileSdk` 36, Maven Central `io.github.feice11:*`, no `material3` dependency): Material 3 Expressive color and type scale paired with iOS 26 interaction, geometry, and interruptible spring motion.
> Read before building apps with Mochi. Apply each rule when your app has the matching scenario; otherwise report "not applicable" with a reason. Explicit user instructions take precedence.

## Core integration baseline

- Call `mochiEnableEdgeToEdge()` in `ComponentActivity.onCreate` before `super.onCreate`, then mount `MochiTheme` + `ProvideMochiOverscroll` +
  `rememberMochiNavigator` / `MochiNavHost` once at the root. Outermost `MochiTheme` manages system-bar icon contrast and wide-gamut windows.
- Host root tabs in `MochiTabScaffold` (per-tab state and scroll preservation, reselect-to-top via `MochiTabReselectHandler`,
  automatic bottom clearance, hides when covered; switch in code via `rememberMochiTabScaffoldState().select(i)`). Use standalone
  `MochiTabBar` + `Modifier.mochiHideWhenCovered()` only for custom shells.
- Choose title scaffolds by outside-card section headings: screens with section labels (such as "Appearance" or "Theme palette")
  use `MochiCompactTitleScaffold` / `MochiLazyCompactTitleScaffold` (or `MochiTitleBar` over an existing scroller) and omit standalone
  large titles while keeping section labels and intro-card titles. Screens without those headings may use `MochiLargeTitleScaffold` /
  `MochiLazyLargeTitleScaffold` (initially expanded on catalog homes, collapsing on upward scroll). Title scaffolds already apply `16.dp`
  horizontal body padding; never nest vertical scrollers or duplicate insets.
- Build long pages with lazy containers (`MochiLazyLargeTitleScaffold`, `MochiLazyCompactTitleScaffold`, or `LazyColumn` + `MochiTitleBar`):
  one section per item, `mochiListSection { rows(...) }` for multi-row cards, `rememberSaveable` for item state, `Modifier.mochiContainedScroll()`
  on nested scrollables, and `MochiScrollDefaults.flingBehavior()` on custom scrollers.

## Navigation and shared toolbars

- Push transitions (`nav.push(route)`): register toolbar controls on both pages with stable, semantic, route-independent `navId` values.
  Shapes pair by side and order; contents pair by `navId`. `MochiBackButton` registers reserved `"mochi.back"` automatically.
- Group two or more adjacent bar actions in `MochiBarGroup(navId = ...)` using `MochiBarGroupItem` or `MochiBarGroupDropdownItem`,
  registering both the group `navId` and each item's `navId` plus a value-stable `contentKey` (enum/constant). Use standalone
  `MochiBarIconButton` or `MochiBarIconDropdown` only for a single action. `MochiBarButton` keys content by its `text` and takes no `contentKey`.
- Open detail pages from cards with `Modifier.mochiNavSource(key, radius, color)` on the whole card and `nav.push(route, from = key)` so the
  entire page (including toolbar) morphs from the card. Match `color` to the card container (`MochiDefaults.groupedContainer()`) and pair
  interactive cards with `mochiPressDeform()` + `mochiPressGlow()` + `clickable(..., indication = null)`. `mochiSharedElement` is deprecated
  and has no effect; use `mochiNavSource` instead.
- Multi-page sheets take a dedicated `MochiNavigator` in both `MochiSheet` and its inner `MochiNavHost` (omit `corners` to inherit sheet
  transition rounding with square bottom corners at full height, and use `MochiSheetHeader`), popping inner routes before dismissing the sheet;
  inner side-pushes draw rounded outlines without dimming the underlying sheet page.

## Lists, layout, and geometry

- Keep one `16.dp` (`MochiListDefaults.RowPadding`) vertical alignment rail per screen. Read colors, continuous shapes (`MochiTheme.shapes`,
  `MochiRoundedRectangle`, `MochiCapsule`, `MochiConcentric`; never `RoundedCornerShape`), and typography (`MochiTheme.textStyles` with
  `.emphasized()` / `.prominent()`, never ad-hoc font sizes) from `MochiTheme` and `MochiDefaults`.
- Grouped lists follow iOS 26 UIKit metrics: `52.dp` minimum row height (`22sp` line height + `15.dp` vertical padding), `16.dp` horizontal
  padding, `26.dp` card radius (`MochiListDefaults.SectionCorner`), `4.dp` title-to-subtitle gap, and `Tile` (`28.dp` + `15.dp` gap) or
  `Symbol` (`24.dp` width + `16.dp` gap) leading icons. Use `MochiListSection` / `MochiListCard` with `MochiListRow`, `MochiListPickerRow`,
  `MochiListDisclosure`, `MochiListSliderRow`, and `MochiSwipeRow`.
- Custom card rows use `clickable(..., indication = null)`, `MochiListDefaults.colors().highlight`, and `mochiListDivider(inset)` with no
  Material ripples. Clip app icons with `clip(MochiRoundedRectangle(size * 0.2237f))` without stacking `mochiBorder` on the same clip, and
  scale Android Adaptive Icon foregrounds by ~`1.4x` to crop the 72/108 safe zone.
- Place unread dots in `titleTrailing` and named states in bottom-right `status` via `MochiListStatusChip`.
- Align `MochiIndexBar` flush at `Alignment.CenterEnd` (no end padding) and reserve `MochiIndexBarDefaults.Width` on list content. Fade
  scrollable horizontal edges with `Modifier.mochiScrollFadeMask(state, extent = 16.dp, vertical = false)` (`ui.feice.mochi.effect.mask`;
  `MochiChipGroup` includes this, passing `contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp), bleed = <padding>` inside padded containers).

## Theme, appearances, and liquid glass

- Wire `colors` (`animateMochiColorScheme`), `LocalMochiControlPalette`, and `materials` once at the root. Never branch on appearance or glass
  switches inside screens, never pass per-appearance colors to components, and animate whole-look switches through `MochiThemeRevealHost`.
- `MochiGlass(style, tint, adaptive, spacing, fallback)` supports `MochiGlassStyle.Regular` (bars, controls, sheets), `MochiGlassStyle.Thick`
  (default for menus and alerts), and `MochiGlassStyle.Frosted`. Configure materials via `mochiGlassMaterials(glass, menu, scrollEdge)` or
  `iosMaterials(glass, blur, glassMaterial)` (`mochi-ios`), and top-bar scroll edges via `MochiScrollEdge` / `MochiTopBarStyle` (`Frosted`,
  `GradientBlur`, `SolidFade`, `TranslucentFade`).
- Theme materials style floating bars, menus, alerts, sheets, and bar controls only; body buttons opt into glass via
  `MochiButtonStyle.ProminentGlass` or `Glass`, while `Filled` and `Tonal` stay solid. For controls floating over scrolling content, use bar
  glass (`MochiBarIconButton`, `MochiBarButton`, or `MochiGlassSurface` over `MochiToolbarScaffold` / `mochiBackdropSource`), never body
  `MochiButtonStyle.Glass`. Glass tab bars support all layouts (labels, icon-only, selected-label, collapse on scroll, search, accessory).
- Custom glass bars pair sibling `Modifier.mochiBackdropSource(backdrop)` content with `LocalMochiBackdrop` (built into `MochiTabScaffold`,
  title scaffolds, `MochiToolbarScaffold`, and `MochiNavHost`). Draw merging or blooming glass pieces inside `MochiGlassGroup` (`bloom`, `pop`,
  `press`). Never apply `Modifier.clip(...)` to `MochiGlassSurface` (clips outer rim highlights and shadows).
- Never place a `WebView` inside `mochiBackdropSource` (prevents Vulkan crashes); isolate WebView regions with `MochiMaterialsScope(MochiMaterials())`
  or `MochiNavHost(windowGlass = false)`. Warn users about GPU/battery cost via `MochiDialog` before enabling liquid glass.
- `mochi-nothing` (`MochiNothingTheme`) overrides colors, typography, and `nothingControlPalette` while keeping Mochi icons, geometry, and readable
  non-dotted Chinese titles (see `docs/guide/nothing-theme.md`). Enable `MochiHdr` / `MochiEdgeGlow` only when hardware and product require HDR.

## Components and controls

- Use `mochi-icons` `MochiIonicon("name")` (`Outline`, `Filled`, `Sharp`), never Material Icons, hand-drawn paths, or emoji. Pass `ImmutableList`
  (`persistentListOf(...)`) to collection parameters. `MochiDialog(icon = { MochiIonicon(...) })` stroke-animates icons automatically.
- Group adjacent body buttons in `MochiButtonGroup` with matching glass/solid styles and semantic `behavior(fuseGroup = ...)`. Use
  `MochiDownloadButton` (`MochiDownloadState.Idle`, `Waiting`, `Loading(progress)`, `Done`) for progressive downloads and `MochiHoldButton` for hold-to-confirm.
- Wrap pages carrying bottom bars in `MochiToolbarScaffold` with `MochiBottomToolbar`, `MochiFloatingToolbar`, `MochiSelectionToolbar`,
  `MochiSearchToolbar`, or `MochiKeyboardToolbar`.
- Use `MochiDropdown` / `MochiIconDropdown`, `MochiContextMenu` (supports `accessory` and custom secondary `MochiItem.panel`), `MochiPopoverButton` /
  `MochiPopoverBox`, `MochiConfirmationDialogBox` / `MochiConfirmationDialog`, `MochiTipCard` / `MochiTipPopover`, and `MochiRadialMenu`
  (`rememberMochiRadialMenuState` + `Modifier.mochiRadialMenuAnchor`).
- Use `MochiChip` / `MochiChipGroup` / `MochiRemovableChip` for filters/tags (never restyled `MochiButton`), `MochiSegmentedControl` for 2-5 inline
  choices, `MochiSelectFrame` + `MochiMiniature` + `MochiSelectionCheck` for visual presets, `MochiTextField(secure = true)` for secrets,
  `MochiEmptyState` for empty views, and `MochiSkeleton` (paired with `rememberMochiNavSettled`) for zero-shift loading placeholders.
- Animate in-place updates with `MochiBlurText`, `MochiBlurCrossfade` / `MochiMorphIcon`, `MochiBlurVisibility`, and `MochiCounterText`. Keep one
  height animation owner per card (`mochiAnimateHeight`, built into `MochiListCard`; pass `animateHeight = false` when inner visibility animates height).

## Copy and visual discipline

- Write direct, factual copy: do not glue titles and counts or states and explanations with `"·"` (put counts in trailing `value` and explanations
  in supporting text), and avoid slogan subtitles, empty superlatives, padded rule-of-three lists, or "not X, but Y" contrasts.
- Keep visuals focused: no emoji decoration, no arbitrary gradient backgrounds, no rainbow icon tiles on every settings row (prefer plain or `Symbol`
  rows when color carries no category meaning), and no unrelated stock scenery on product cards. See section 5 of `docs/guide/application-integration.md`.

## Verification and delivery

- Respect the user's verification scope: report formatting/compilation, automated JVM/screenshot tests, and interactive/on-device validation separately,
  never claiming visual or gesture verification from compilation alone.
- Preserve accessibility and system contracts: minimum `44.dp` touch targets, icon `contentDescription`, real `enabled` states, gesture cancellation
  cleanup, safe-area and physical-corner insets, pre-API-33 fallbacks, and `LocalMochiReduceMotion`.
- In application deliveries, list each applicable integration requirement with its code location, or mark it "not applicable" with a specific reason.
